source: Pinned source tree in paper_runs/paper_replication_audits/finagent/manifest.json; source content hashes captured by runner
primary_comparison: Native causal validation versus the same pipeline with retrieved past-memory items withheld; current news, charts, native reflections, tools and own-account feedback retained
preserved: Five source prompt stages and train/valid HTML templates
Actual image inputs and vision calls
Source FAISS memory and diverse-query construction
Shared source-style training using within-training future supervision
Native whole-share cash/position accounting and 10bp transaction fees
repairs: Training dataset physically ends before validation, including forward-supervision data
Validation state look_forward_days=0, and every chart asserts latest price <= decision date
Validation decisions execute at next close via a pending-order queue
Second-resolution memory IDs replaced with deterministic collision-free IDs
Released rule strategies execute with source defaults; opaque result summaries replaced by explicitly labelled chronological training-only accounts
Prompt artifacts stored in SQLite, same content; charts use two reusable files with all dated images archived as SQLite BLOBs

Validation NAV is marked and prior orders filled at the current close before the actor reads its account. The released environment attaches previous-close NAV to the next date; training retains the literal source behavior, while validation uses native buy/sell quantity methods under the repaired clock.

Executed validation actions retain the corresponding prior decision reasoning in the reflection history; current decision reasoning is recorded separately. This corrects the one-session delay consistently.
adaptations: Date-only news lagged one trading session
Current GPT-4o replaces unavailable GPT-4 preview and GPT-4 vision preview snapshots
Matplotlib candlestick and executed-account charts replace ECharts browser rendering
Missing original guidance, sentiment, economic and historical memory snapshots remain unavailable
One ticker/seed, not all paper assets/trials
source_native_end_convention: The final trading date receives a terminal current-close valuation and any pending execution, but no new model decision.
technical_persistence_recovery: On 2026-09-07, a shared SQLite write-lock failure led to an fsynced append-journal cache. Five unavailable responses retain $0.2640905 of reservations project-wide; each receives at most one explicit technical recovery under the same model/input recipe, with both attempts counted. No completed case outcome was used to select a recovery response.
template_setup_correction: The first four generic trading-template training days are archived as a setup probe. Those templates omitted tool sections. Before any validation outcomes, the complete released template variant was selected so actual source strategy tools reach the model; all setup spend remains counted.
embedding_transport: The released OpenAIProvider executes its original per-document token-ID chunking and normalized weighted embedding computation. Independent document calls are prefetched concurrently; documents are not merged into an embedding batch.
validation_execution: Two independent validation processes after shared training; separate RNGs, accounts and artifact stores; identical in-flight embedding requests wait for a shared cached result.
embedding_audit_corrections: The initial Ada002 choice did not match the released emb_model configuration. It is retired as setup; the primary run uses the source text-embedding-3-large model and3072 dimensions.

A batching optimization was rejected:126/306 matched Ada input vectors differed, with maximum component difference0.002861643; the first changed retrieval was2022-06-17 and decisions later diverged. Three initial spot checks were insufficient. All setup responses/spend and the failed full-prefix check remain archived.
source_settings_change: Restore released provider default temperature1.0; same current GPT4o model substitution disclosed, original historical preview snapshots unavailable.
scope: All five source equity configs, one trajectory each; ETHUSD/data and multiple model trajectories remain separate gaps.
